incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gateway_5xx_rate high (5m avg 9.2%) service=gateway-prod. Paging samir (oncall).
samir (oncall): on it. pulling up traces/dashboards and recent config changes.
kelly (eng-runtime): looks like a route config PR merged 05:03 UTC that adjusted weights for region-na. blue -> 0, green -> 100. sudden traffic shift.
diego (sre): Envoy clusters show upstream_rq_5xx and upstream_rq_timeout spikes at 05:06. also envoys returned 502s and some 504s from connect timeouts.
ira (infra): deploybot logs show PR #589 merged at 05:02 and rollout finished at 05:03. CI passed. validator didn't flag weight jumps.
samir (oncall): are retries enabled? if so, that can amplify failures when a subset of hosts get overloaded.
kelly (eng-runtime): yes, retry policy on route: retry_on: "5xx,connect-failure,reset", num_retries: 2, per_try_timeout: 1500ms. per-try may cause quick backs into same unhealthy backend.
diego (sre): evidence of retry amplification: retry_attempts/sec jumped in line with 5xx. chart: https://console.redwood/ops/dash/gateway/retries_vs_5xx
samir (oncall): okay emergency plan: (1) disable retries for the impacted route, (2) temporarily relax circuit_breaker hard limits, (3) rollback weight change if needed. I'll take 1.
kelly (eng-runtime): i'll prepare cb relax patch and test rollback sequence.
samir (oncall): applying emergency patch to remove retry policy now.
samir (oncall): ```
# emergency change: remove retries from route region-na -> backend
route_config:
  - name: region-na
    retry_policy: null
``` 
incident-bot: change requested by samir (oncall)  change-id: emchg-20260314-0508  status: queued
ira (infra): approving emergency deploy gate. rolling to edge proxies in region-na.
incident-bot: deploy emchg-20260314-0508 started by infra-deploy-bot at 05:09 UTC.
kelly (eng-runtime): while that's rolling, applying a soft increase to cb thresholds on backend-primary cluster.
kelly (eng-runtime): ```
# cb temp patch
cluster: backend-primary
circuit_breakers:
  thresholds:
    - max_connections: 450
      max_pending_requests: 250
``` 
diego (sre): after retries removed and cb relaxed, 5xx started to decline within ~60s. upstream_rq_5xx peaked at ~17% then fell to ~3.5% over 4 minutes.
megan (customer-success): customers pinging support. can we get a short status message to send now?
samir (oncall): TL;DR for customers: "A routing change concentrated traffic to fewer hosts, causing overloaded backends and elevated errors. We disabled retries and adjusted circuit breakers; errors are falling and we're investigating root cause. We'll follow up with a postmortem." I'll post to status page and share with you.
ira (infra): filing INF-947 to add validator rule: disallow immediate weight jumps > 50% without staged flag. assigning to infra.
kelly (eng-runtime): adding ENG-807 to add a canary rollout controller for route weight changes and a cross-metric alert detecting retry amplification.
diego (sre): root cause notes: validator allowed abrupt weight change; combined with global retry policy and low per-try timeout, retries hit the same overloaded hosts resulting in retry storms and CB tripping.
kelley (eng-runtime): small correction: per-try timeout being short meant retries were attempted quickly and retried into still-unhealthy hosts. adding backoff + jitter will help long-term.
samir (oncall): handing off incident to kelly (eng-runtime) for deeper investigation. I'll stay available until 06:00 UTC.
incident-bot: oncall handoff samir (oncall) -> kelly (eng-runtime) at 05:18 UTC. Paging cleared.
kelly (eng-runtime): taking over. I'll reproduce locally and test a safer retry config: idempotent-only + exponential backoff + jitter.
megan (customer-success): sent initial customer notifications to Acme, SyncChat, EduCloud. customers appreciated quick mitigation and asked for postmortem.
diego (sre): recommend actionable retro items: (1) validator rule for abrupt weight changes, (2) add a retry amplification alert (increase in retries + 5xx), (3) default retry policies to conservative backoff and idempotent methods only, (4) add per-host load-shedding.
ira (infra): also adding a deploybot flag to require a canary if weight delta > 30%.
kelly (eng-runtime): monitoring now: current 5xx ~1.1% and steady. will keep watches on for 45 minutes before re-enabling retries anywhere.
incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: 5xx returned to within SLOs. Postmortem pending (assign: eng-runtime + infra + sre).
